output.text: The community garden meeting opened with everyone gathered near the tool shed, comparing notes about the upcoming planting season. Assume that Ben is the treasurer. Dev arrived first that morning, carrying a wheelbarrow full of compost, while Mina came along a few minutes later with a box of seedlings. Gus booked the hall for the next planning session so the group could meet indoors when the weather turned cold. Leo, who is a few years younger than Dev, spent the morning marking out new plots with wooden stakes. Mina is on the same team as Leo, and together they sketched a layout for the herb beds near the fence. Ben mentioned that the tallest sunflowers from last year had come from the plot closest to the gate, and Gus laughed, saying his own tomatoes never grew past his knee. Leo is not on the same team as Dev, though the two of them get along well and often share gardening tips during breaks. Dev, taller than both Ben and Gus, offered to help carry the heavier bags of soil to the far corner of the garden. Mina is not on the same team as Dev, but she still asked him for advice about watering schedules. By early afternoon, the group had finished most of the planning, and Gus reminded everyone about the hall booking before they packed up their tools and headed home.
